exposure: obstetric events (prematurity, birth weight, caesarean section)
cohort: The study included 102 third-trimester pregnant women followed to six weeks post-partum and 102 age-matched community controls.
finding: In this Romanian cohort, heightened state anxiety, in synergy with high neuroticism and lower openness, was the dominant risk factor for early onset PPD.
mod_finding: Obstetric factors, including delivery mode (caesarean section), were not significant predictors of post-partum depression.
